# ship-rules

Your interface to the `rules` ops. Invoke each over ConnectRPC:

```
ship ops call <name> --json '<args-json>'
```

Reads are safe (C0). Commands carry a blast-radius class. Open an op's reference
page for full args, return shape, capability, and an example.

## Reads

- [`rules.list`](references/docs/rules.list.mdoc) — List markdown rules across scopes.
- [`rules.get`](references/docs/rules.get.mdoc) — Raw rule body at the requested scope.

## Commands

- [`rules.create`](references/docs/rules.create.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Create a new markdown rule (errors if the id is taken).
- [`rules.put`](references/docs/rules.put.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Replace a rule's body (use rules.create for net-new).
- [`rules.delete`](references/docs/rules.delete.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Trash a rule (scope omitted walks project → user).
